mapper.select: SELECT s.uuid AS shareID, f.user_id AS userId, u.username, f.favorite_name AS favoritesName, f.card_id AS cardIds, f.look_count AS lookCount, f.like_count AS likeCount, s.expire_time AS expireTime FROM share s JOIN favorites f ON f.favorite_id=s.favorites_id JOIN user u ON u.userid=f.user_id WHERE s.uuid=#{shareId} AND s.expire_time>now()
